@June, Gideon closed **ticket #8841** with support on 1 Jul. He said the fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing department without a custom CSV export.

One caveat: later strategic digests mention #8841 as an open Dock Door 14 kiosk problem (30 Sep, escalated to platform engineering). Either the ticket was reopened or the number was reused, so it may be worth checking the ticket record before the QBR.
